::: {#sol-doubling-guess}

| $n$ | 0 | 1 | 2 | 3 | 4 | 5 |
|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|:---:|
| $a_n$ | 2 | 3 | 5 | 9 | 17 | 33 |
| $2^n$ | 1 | 2 | 4 | 8 | 16 | 32 |

Each term is one more than the power below it, so a good guess is $a_n = 2^n + 1$.
Six terms do not prove the guess for every $n$.

:::
